name: Jellybutter Visualizer
overview: A MilkDrop 2 music visualizer (Butterchurn) inside the Jellyfin web client and Jellyfin Desktop.
description: Adds a Butterchurn (MilkDrop 2, WebGL) visualizer to the Jellyfin web client. A button in the Now Playing controls (and a floating one elsewhere) opens it full screen with random presets that cycle automatically, optionally with the track's lyrics over it and the Now Playing bar along the bottom, keyboard shortcuts (v toggle, l lyrics, b next, n previous, Escape close), and D-pad, remote and gamepad navigation of its controls. On Jellyfin Desktop, music is routed through the web player so the visualizer can hear it while video stays on mpv. Everything is served by the plugin; nothing is loaded from the internet.
changelog:
1.4.1.0 - The release zip carries THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt with the license texts of the embedded Butterchurn and butterchurn-presets. No change in behavior.
1.4.0.0 - The floating visualizer button's bars bounce while music plays (still with reduced motion). Unsynced lyrics (no timestamps) no longer scroll with the track: they sit still, sized or set in columns to fit the screen, with an "Unsynced lyrics" badge in the corner. No page scrollbar beside the open visualizer.
1.3.0.0 - The TV layout gets a Now Playing bar under the visualizer (track, artwork, transport controls, time). D-pad, remote and gamepad navigation while the visualizer is open: any key wakes the controls, arrows move between them and the bar, Back closes. "No lyrics found" in a dimmer, lighter note.
1.2.0.0 - Renamed to Jellybutter Visualizer (settings carry over). The web client's Now Playing bar shows along the bottom of the visualizer, on by default.
1.1.0.0 - A visualizer button in the Now Playing controls (between Lyrics and Shuffle); a lyrics view over the visualizer (l key, Lyrics button) fed by Jellyfin's Lyrics API; settings for the buttons, the opening view and the lyrics size.
1.0.1.0 - Settings page: the version label works and help tooltips stay inside the window.
1.0.0.0 - First release: Butterchurn visualizer with auto-cycling presets, hotkeys, a focusable toggle button, and web-player audio on Jellyfin Desktop.
